Share of people (%) moving up, down or not at all a percentile and a decile of equivalised household net income because of each measure and the combined run, by starting decile and overall, by year (2026-2031), from generate --only income_distribution --backend modal on the bundle's Microcosm UK 2024-25 dataset (policyengine 6.10.2, policyengine-uk 2.132.6). Each household is ranked among everyone before the measure and among everyone after it. A share of movers drawn from fewer than 10 distinct survey households is left blank, with the matching share staying put. No ids, weights or counts. No area below the UK.
